perplexity.description:
Hasabe – My Worries by Ayalew Mesfin, originally released in 2018 on Now-Again Records, is a landmark compilation that gathers the most vital recordings of one of Ethiopia’s pioneering Ethio-groove artists. The album showcases Mesfin’s signature blend of funk, soul, and traditional Ethiopian melodies, delivered with the tight grooves of his Black Lion Band. Tracks like “Libe Menta Hone” and “Hasabe (My Worries)” highlight his innovative use of minor-key modalities, hypnotic rhythms, and socially conscious lyrics, all hallmarks of the 1970s Addis Ababa music scene. The sound is both danceable and introspective, reflecting the cultural ferment and political tension of the era.

This release marks the first comprehensive presentation of Ayalew Mesfin’s music in album form, drawing from rare 7” singles and reel-to-reel tapes that had previously circulated only within Ethiopia. Forced underground by the Derg regime in 1974, Mesfin’s work remained largely unknown outside his homeland until this collection brought his artistry to a global audience. Hasabe – My Worries is widely regarded as a crucial rediscovery in world music, praised for its raw energy, emotional depth, and historical significance. The album received critical acclaim for illuminating a long-overlooked chapter in African funk and soul, and it has since become a touchstone for fans of global groove music.
